Messages.Author: Tibicenas
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : Nergal Summoner
Author : Tibicenas
Description :
Turbo Nergal + Striga + Shatter

Crypt [12 vampires] Capacity min: 3 max: 10 average: 8.25
6x Nergal 10 AUS DAI FOR OBF PRE THA Baali:5
3x Nergal Adv 10 AUS DAI FOR OBF PRE THA Baali:5
3x Horde, The 3 dai obf pre Baali:6

Library [90 cards]
Action [15]
1x Call the Great Beast
2x Condemnation: Doomed
1x Contagion
2x Rutor's Hand
9x Shatter the Gate

Action Modifier [12]
3x Forgotten Labyrinth
6x Freak Drive
3x Psychomachia

Action Modifier/Combat [3]
3x Swallowed by the Night

Combat [18]
8x Hexe
6x Superior Mettle
4x Theft of Vitae

Equipment [2]
1x Helicopter
1x Kaymakli Fragment

Master [12]
2x Blood Doll
2x Fame
1x Giant's Blood
1x Rack, The
6x Striga

Reaction [22]
2x Diabolic Lure
2x Enhanced Senses
6x On the Qui Vive
3x Scobax
3x Spirit's Touch
6x Strix

Reaction/Action Modifier [6]
6x Sense the Sin

The idea of the deck is oust with nergal bleeds and Shatter the Gate. So I make this semi blocker deck in order to protect the gates, I got the Hordes to protect Nergal from Pentex Subersion, be rescued from torpot, etc., ganing pool/blood with the Kaymakli and the Rack (I got only 1 copy of these cards but the deck it's supposed to be a fast moving card deck), and with a B plan with the Great Beast.

I've tested this deck in three games, the first game was ok but the next two I get owned by a Spiritus deck, getting Nergal stolen by my predator first and bruned by my prey in combat in the second game (Striga at inferior and no FOR cards in hand), both games at the 2nd/3rd round of game.

Now I'm doubting about two options: erase all combat cards and make an ordinary "Majesty" combat deck, using Striga only to gain intercept and Strix with 3 Hexes as surprises or just erase all the OBF and deny cards to make a real and competitive fighting deck and add some intercept.

I must say that I'm a little bit Newbie on Vtes (only 1 year playing and 0 torunaments), so don't get mad if my deck is absolutely useless

Try to trim your crypt:
5x Nergal
1x Nergal Adv
6x The Horde

And put 2 Epiphany into the library.

> Tibicenas wrote:
> Library [90 cards]
>
Try to cut down your deck to 60 cards.
For a trick deck, less cards is definitely better.

If you have an Enkil-Cog, use it to take 3 actions in a row:
during your predator's turn to play Shatter#1, during your turn to play Shatter#2, during your prey's turn, to play Shatter#3.
You can use Eluding the Arms of Morpheus to untap during your prey/predator's actions (use it on actions that have inbuilt stealth).
That way, you have only to defend the Shatters against your prey.

Messages.Author: Xaddam
Messages.Body:
I have actually had a deck like this built for a few months. 4 out of 5 games I got 3 shatters in play, I think.

My reasoning is that as long as you get 3 shatters in play, you'll pretty much win or die. So I don't have any +bleed cards. If I would build this deck again I would remove the thefts and adding kevlar vest and/or flak jacket as well as some more stealth. Dunno what to remove, though. Maybe scobax.
